alex_pm: Quick ask  we need a concise paid plan for the webinar push (search + retarget + creative refresh). 72h timeline. Target: 1k regs, CPA $40. Short bullets pls.
talia_paid: Search: focus on intent phrases only. Create two SKUs: Registrations (exact) + Info (phrase). Pause broad match. Use sitelinks to webinar agenda + speakers.
jamie_creative: Creative refresh: one new motion GIF (15s) + static variant. Headline test: (1) "Scale LLM inference in production" (2) "Cut inference costs by 3x". Keep speaker names in retargets.
noah_ops: Retargeting: build 3 lists: 1) 14d page visitors (all pages), 2) 7d video viewers (>=50%), 3) 30d trial starters. Sequence: video viewers -> testimonial -> pricing page visitors -> CTA reminder.
talia_paid: Budget pacing: set a weekly cap and daily caps with ramping. Rule: 40% budget first 6 hours after email send, 25% next 12h, remainder evenly. Use target CPA bidding but allow 20% bid inflation for first 24h to capture surge.
ads-bot: [overlap-check] audience overlap detected: 7d_video & 14d_site = 38% overlap. Recommend exclusion window or sequential creative.
jamie_creative: Good call. I'll prepare testimonial cut for the video list and more product-focused for site visitors. Also provide alt CTAs: Register / Watch on Demand.
noah_ops: Tracking: add utm_source=email, utm_campaign=web_mar, hidden field bucket=web_live. Map bucket to Salesforce Lead Type=Webinar. Push hot leads to #sales-live.
alex_pm: Landing page experiment? Quick idea: control = hero + CTA, variant = hero + 3-bullet agenda + one-liner speaker creds. 90/10 split favoring agenda variant for paid.
talia_paid: Ad naming: `web_mar_72h_Search_reg_exact_v1` and `web_mar_72h_Ret_vid7_testimonial_v1`. Keep consistent to avoid reporting noise.
ads-bot: [performance-tuner] set alert: CPA > $60 for 2 consecutive hours -> pause underperforming ad groups. Also flag CTR < 0.5% after 6h.
jamie_creative: I'll upload assets to the ad account and label them with audience targets. Motion thumbnail + 2 headlines by EOD.
noah_ops: Exclude converters for 30 days from retarget. Also cap frequency to 5 impressions/day for retargeting.
talia_paid: Quick win: increase bids for top-converting keywords by 15% in the 2 hours post-email when people are most active. Then scale back.
alex_pm: Who owns live monitoring? I'll watch channel and dashboard. Talia, can you own bid adjustments first 24h?
talia_paid: Yep. I'll also enable accelerated delivery first 12h then switch to standard.
alex_pm: Great. Sync 30 min pre-send to confirm tags and pixels. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
